title: Indian firms trust AI. 75% still await returns
takeaways_title: AI adoption in India, in 5 numbers
takeaways: 82% of Indian leaders have high or complete confidence in their AI use.
75% say AI returns don't yet justify the money and effort.
74% have not formally calculated AI ROI with finance.
28% let GenAI run processes end-to-end, vs 19% across markets.
$79.1 billion: possible GDP gain in ten years, moderate case.
source_note: Sources: Avanade via The Tribune/ANI, 3 Nov 2026; Ayre Think Tank via IANS, 5 Nov 2026
